fn: Plan map (Plan, Section and 3D) now has a Full screen mode. Tap the new full screen button next to the hole count (top right of the map header, or in the map tools) to hide the app bar, the view tabs and the bottom panel so the map fills the whole screen. The Plan / Section / 3D tabs stay as a small pill, the menu button at the bottom right brings the Show / Labels / Map panel back as a sheet, and the X button (or Esc) exits.
